verdict.rationale: Formant is a cloud fleet-operations platform, so a sandbox or test environment isolated from production data is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, staging org, test tenant, simulated devices, or dry-run mode. Agent environment variables, re-provisioning and configuration templates are adjacent features and do not isolate test work from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
